summary: Add prompt instruction to treat negative tool findings as probabilistic and re-examine pixels when tools disagree or high-res tools fail.

edits.hypothesis: Adding explicit instructions to treat negative tool outputs as probabilistic and to re-examine original pixels when tools disagree or high-resolution tools fail will reduce uncritical acceptance of false negatives.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The failure mode is driven by the agent's interpretation of tool outputs as definitive truth; a prompt edit directly addresses this cognitive bias by changing the decision rule for handling negative/failed evidence.
edits.trigger_condition: always (applies to all final answer stages)
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) q000001: Agent would have been instructed to not accept 'No' from chest_xray_expert/llava_med_qa as definitive, potentially leading to re-examination or uncertainty. q000005: Agent would have been instructed to not accept normal findings after roi_crop failure, potentially leading to different conclusion. (preservative) q000003: Direct visual reasoning success habit preserved as prompt only adds caution for negative/failed tool cases. (transfer) Generalizes to any task where tools return negative findings that contradict ground truth.
edits.regression_risk: May cause over-caution or hesitation in clear negative cases, but unlikely to break correct positive identifications.
edits.mechanism: Adding explicit instructions to treat negative tool outputs as probabilistic and to re-examine original pixels when tools disagree or high-resolution tools fail will reduce uncritical acceptance of false negatives.
